UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public user profile for a CodeKaro developer account.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

username.description: Unique handle derived from name or email.

displayName.description: Full display name of the user.

provider.description: Authentication provider used (google, github, or email).

otpVerified.description: Whether the user completed OTP or OAuth verification.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

UserPrivate.title: UserPrivate
UserPrivate.description: Isolated private PII record for a CodeKaro user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this private record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when private record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public developer profiles indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores isolated private PII (email) accessible strictly by the document owner.
